tonight.headline: 49-51 — and Tuten did not practise
body: Bad news first. Tuten did not practise Wednesday with the foot and ankle (Schefter, 21:13Z), and Footballers own Chris Rodriguez Jr., the back who starts if he sits. Likely is now questionable too: a groin from last week's practice, limited Wednesday, though Rotoworld calls that a good sign. Diggs, your first bench receiver, missed Wednesday for a personal reason. You are 4-7.
ESPN has it 130.0 to 131.8, 49%. The lineup is the projection lineup; nothing to move today. Two decisions are made in advance for Sunday 10:30: Tuten's and Likely's.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Tuten sits, Rodriguez runs for Footballers against the league's softest run defence, and Likely sits with no tight end added — a zero in the TE slot.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten practising Thursday or Friday, or Likely upgraded to full. Either moves the Sunday plan back to 'start as set'.

doFirst.title: If Tuten is inactive, start Etienne
doFirst.subtitle: Tuten starts if active. Etienne, not Diggs: Diggs missed Wednesday and plays after every other option has locked.

case.label: The player
case.body: Did not practise Wednesday, foot and ankle (Schefter 25 Nov 21:13Z) — this morning Coen was still talking about a limited week. A high ankle sprain since Week 8, re-aggravated in Week 11. ESPN still projects 18.7; Thursday's and Friday's reports decide it.

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Etienne (12.0, NO at CIN, Sun 12:00) into the RB slot. This morning's alternative — Gordon to RB, Diggs (12.7) into FLEX — is 0.7 better on projection, a coin flip, but Diggs had an excused absence Wednesday (Yahoo 20:09Z) and kicks off at 15:25, after Etienne, Ayomanor, Metcalf and Waddle have all locked. If Diggs then sat, the seat would score zero.
